verdict.rationale: Docs show a single call (getSandbox()) creates or reconnects to an isolated, VM-based sandbox, after which exec/writeFile/etc. work immediately, matching the 'one API call, live env' story. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of actual cold-start latency for Cloudflare's own sandbox (community benchmarks cited are about competitors' similar Firecracker systems, not Cloudflare's, so speed-in-seconds claim isn't independently confirmed) and no data on isolation guarantees under load.
